stories.title: Have fun! Don't dig holes in the outfield! MLB players give their Little League advice
stories.summary: We asked major leagues what one piece of advice from their youth baseball days stuck with them -- and what advice they'd give now. Here's what they said.

stories.title: TE to go from Browns to LSU in historic twist
stories.summary: The Browns are waiving tight end Dae'Quan Wright, who has an agreement in place for the 2026 season to play for LSU if he clears waivers, agents Drew Rosenhaus and Kyle Lincoln told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Monken: Watson comments not factor in QB call
stories.summary: Browns coach Todd Monken said that he anticipates naming a starting quarterback Monday and that Deshaun Watson's postgame comments Saturday won't factor into his decision.

stories.title: 49ers' Kittle off PUP list, CMC returns to practice
stories.summary: The 49ers have activated tight end George Kittle from the PUP list as he chases a return for Week 1 against the Rams.

stories.title: Lamb's home burglarized while WR was at camp
stories.summary: CeeDee Lamb's home in Fairview, Texas, was burglarized while he was attending training camp with the Dallas Cowboys in Oxnard, California, according to police.
